description: Plan F advance — tr_M(T_w, q_0) via the 3A-strand atom-braid convention for proton, neutron, deuteron, tritium, ³He, evaluated at q_0 to 50 dps via the Hoefsmit + Wenzl bridge (Σ_λ y_λ · χ_λ) and (where applicable) compared against the published Jones polynomial of the historical knot ID. Companion to proton-mass-mpfr-50dps.witness.json.  Tritium / ³He at H_9 unblocked vs. legacy sympy path (>4-min timeout).
method: hoefsmit_wenzl_bridge: tr_M(W) = Σ_{λ ⊢ n} y_λ(q) · χ_λ(W); y_λ from y-lambda-mpfr-witness.json; χ_λ via per-partition Young-seminormal matrices in mpmath (sparse COO) at 50 dps; W is the atom_braid_word_3A Hecke-factor word
structural_reference: prop:full-pole-structure-mass-trace — tr_M(T_w, q) is meromorphic in q with simple poles at every primitive root of unity ζ_n^(j) (gcd(j,n)=1, n>=2); this witness reports tr_M evaluated at q = q_0 ≈ 1.11, the regular point used throughout the paper.  The prop's Mittag-Leffler / Habiro cyclotomic expansion expresses the same function as a sum over these poles; Habiro's convergence theorem guarantees the order-m Habiro truncation neglects only the ζ_1, …, ζ_m residues, so the values reported here are the LHS of the prop's equations (Mittag-Leffler eq. and Habiro eq.) at q = q_0.
precision_caveat: y-lambda-mpfr-witness.json was computed with q at f64 precision (its 'q' field stores str(float(Q0))); the y_λ values inherit f64-limited input. Bridge results agree with the prop-table canonical values to ~1e-15. To upgrade to full 50-dps precision, regenerate that witness with q_str at 50 dps (see y_lambda_mpfr_witness.py).

historical_K_comparison.note: If the ratio is a power of q_0, then tr_M = q_0^k · J_K, i.e. they agree up to writhe normalisation. q_0 = 1.1099785955541805752815940796..., so log(ratio)/log(q_0) should be close to an integer.
